text: يَمْ لٗتٗلِنْنَ، اِلْمُوُ كِمِيَ بي جَامِءَ ستَنْفوْدْ بي مِارَنْتَنْزَ لِيِتَبَي تَنْدوْ كَرَي تشِدَ بي كُوَسُوَ كُلَسْتَبي سَيلْ سوْءَ جِلِنْزَمينْ غَيَرْجِنْمَ وَرْمَجِا :تشِبْ بَكْتِنْمَ تشِلْلُوُلا مُوَنْزٗ اِنْجِنْبَكْتَبي اِنْكْجَيْتْ لَنْ نوْءَتَ دٗنْ تْتَنْدِنْمٖ سَينتْ فَلْ U.S بي
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: كُلَشَوُ كُرَكُرَيَ اَدَ اَدٗيَ دَتَيْنْ تُنُ كَنْسَ بي سو، كُوَسُوَ كَنْجَوْ بي سو، تِبِ سوْ،مَلَرِيَ سوْءَ فَودُتٗ اَمْ دوْنْدِ لَرْدٗوَ دُنوْ غَنَءَ بيْ روْ سُوُدِنْ نَ دو كٗرْمُ دَلِلْ كوسُوَ جِلِ كَنْسَ نغَنْجِ بي مُوَنْزٗ رَيْتَ لَرْدٗوَ فُوُزَنَ يَ رو وَلْجِنْمَ.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: JAS 39C غٗرِفِنْدٗ دَنْدَلْ مَارَ تشِتٗيِ فَلْلُ تشِكُرُ سَ 9:30am (0230 UTC) سُوَ يِدَيْ كُرُ كَلْلَتٗ ، يَفُتْ دٗ مَارَا كَسُوبِرُ زَكْكُنُ
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: دٗرَيْبَ مَارَ بي دٗ شِمَ سٗكوَدْرونْ لِيدَ دِلوكْرِتْ بَتْتَفي.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: حَوَرْرَ فَتوْبي يَ مُوتَ كونْنُ يَزوبَيْ دَنْدَل مارَ سَمِ بَي اِسٗنَ سَ حَوَرْ سَدْنَ.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: بِيدَلْ سَا 28 أَدٗ بَاسَرُ سِيزٗنْ يَكْكِ كُزٗنَ دٗنْ كٗلْلَتٗ سِبِلْلَ لَنْ
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: بٗرْنِ كَتَلَنْيِرُ كَوْ إِسٗنَدٗنْ بِدَلْيِ كُلُفْدٗنْ بِكْكِ 49 بِكْكِزُ
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: زَنْغَزَنْغَدٗ سَ 11:00 يِدَيْ بَدِيَتٗ (UTC+1) كٗلَ وَيْت حُلْ أَرْمٗسْكٗ غَوُرَمْ دَلِيَيِ غَدِزَيْن لَيْ دَوْنِنْيِ دٗنْ فَتُ فٗرَيْم مِنِسْتَيِ غُمْنَتِلَيِ
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: نغَوُ سَ 11:00 يِ كَلْلَنْ، زَنْغَزَنْغَوُيِ لِتٗ أََوَا كٗمْبَيِ كٗلَ لَيْ يَلَيْ وَيْت حُلْيِدٗنْ رُوَدَ
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: سَ 11:20 لَنْ دَلِوَادٗيِ زَنْغَزَنْغَوْدٗرُ نغَوزَ كٗلَ زَوَلْ شِيِدٗرُ زَسَوَ أَدَ، سَنْدِيِ حَقْقُنْزَ زَنْغَزَنْغَ دِيُيِدٗأَ لِتٗ مُتُيِ رُوتٗأَ كَلْكَلْتٗ مٗرَدٗزَنَ أَدَ دَلِوَادٗيِ.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: سَ 11:29 يِدَيْلَنْ، زنْغَزَنْغَدٗ وَيْت حُلْ لَنْ فُوزٗ تٗلَفَلْغَ سٗكُوَايَ كُزٗ، لَيْ سٗتٗرَنْيِمِنْ، أَلْدوِتْشمِنْ كُزٗ دَيِ كِنْغسوِي رُجُوَ كٗلَ حُلْبُنْنَ نَدُنِ كُنْسَبِيتِبْ فَاتِدٗ نجِمْمَ غِرَنْ كُنْنَوْت حُتِلْيِلَنْ سٗفٗرِنْْغ فُورُمْزَ سَدِنْدٗنْ.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: رِكُدْ نَدَلْيِ نغٗمْمَ نغٗمْمَيِ شَ بِكْكِمَ كَنَدَيْيَدٗ شِمَ 7-2
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: كَرٗنْغٗرُ رَوْنِتْشيِ شَ جُوُ بٗرِسْبَنْ أُفٗنْ لَنْ
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: نَدَلْيِ دِكْكِلْدٗنْ تشِ 88% زُ كُرُ 76 بِكْكِ بُرُيْدٗنْ زُ
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: نغَوُ دِكْكِلْ دِنْ ، مَيْ كُلُنْيِ كِنْغ اُفْ كٗلِي وُنُ كَرُونيِ زَوْرُ كٗجِ دِكْكِلْلَ دَرِي كٗلِلِ شِيَيْ بَيْدٗرُ وَلْتٗكِ إِسْكٗنَ دٗرُ . نَادٗرُ جَرَمْنٗمْ بُورُ كَدِكُ
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "ككْكَدِيَ فَنَمَيِ دٗ كَكْكَدِيَ" مِلِيُنْ مِوْيِدَيْ تشِدَرَمْ شَرَيْ مُوسَكْ فُنْسِكَيِ حَوَرْوُرُ أَشِرْمِنْ نٗنْغٗرِ سَ 2016 يِ لَنْ تشِنَدٗرُ غُلْتِنْ.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: كَكْكَدِيَ دٗيِ بَنْكٗأَ مِوْدِيرِ فٗلِزٗنَ لُوَيَوُنْزَ غَرِوْوَ بَنَزَ لٗمَنْ US دُولَيِ بِلِيُنْ كَدَ غٗرَزَنَ حَرَجِيَا كَيِدَا غَدِيَرُ كَتٗرُ
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: جَرِدَ لَرْدٗ بٗرِتٗنْيِ دِ غَادِيِنْيِ دُتْش بَانْكٗدٗ تشِ يَكْكِ سُرُ كَنْفَنِيَ شِلْ يِ 1200 فيْدَتٗ أَوُ أَدٗ تٗدٗنَدٗ سُنُتِنْ وُنُ
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: زَنْغَزَنْغَ دِنَ سَمْمَسُنْ وَازٗنَ ، شَرَ كَدَ تٗدٗنَ ، كُرُ كُرَا لَرْدٗ أَيْسلَنْديِأَ فَكِسْتَنْيِأَ كٗرْمَيْ كُلْلَدَ
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: مَا هُنْكُن لَنْ كَتَمْبُ، جَامِيَ نِوْيُكْيِأَ مَارَنْتَ شَرَيْ حَبَتْيِأَ لَنْ كٗرَانُ كُرُ فَلْلُ “غٗرِنْ كَدْ“ أَمِيرِكَ لَنْ تشُتْتُ نَفْتٗيِ رُوزٗنَ.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: حِسِحْ لُكْتُ كَرْنُيِدٗنْ وُنُ نَدٗ وَنَيْ لَرْدٗدٗ سُوسٗ كُلْجِنْ سَ فِتٗنَلَا وَاجِيَ
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: حِسِحْيِ مَا دُنِ فُتُ غُتٗ سٗرَنَدٗ كَمْ كٗلَ فٗلِتٗ سٗرَنَ غِيمَا أَفْفِمَبَ وُنُ
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: زُرْتٗأَ أَيْ سَمْمَسُنْ، مَايِ فُتُ نغٗلَرُ كٗلَ نغٗرْوُ دُ أَلَكَ دُنُوَ سُرُوَ تشَيْنَيْرُ غُزٗيِنْ لَنْ زُونَ.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: بِكْكِمَ يِمْيِ كُيِدٗ شِمَ أَلِكْس أُبِتشْكِنْ وَشِنْتُنْ كَفِتَلْسيِدٗ.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: شِيِ كُرُ إِنْدِ 2 زُونَ كُرُ إنْدِ 2 بَنَزٗ تُونَ دِكْكِلْ دُنِ وَشِنْتُنْيِ 5 -3 رُ أَتْلَنْتَسْ تٗرَشَسْأَ زُونَدٗنْ
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: أُبِكْتشِنْيِ بَنَزٗ كُرُ بُوُ بُرُسَلَكْيِدٗ شِمَ كُرُ بِكْكِ زُيِنْمَ بَدِتٗمَ نِكْلَسْ بَكْسٗتٗرُمْيِ زُنَدٗ
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: كُرُنْزٗ كٗنْ إِنْدِمِ بٗنِ أَدِيِ دٗ شِمَ 60 نْزِوُ سِيزٗنْ أَدٗلَنْ ، بِكْكِمَ بُرُسَلَكْكِ كُرُ 60 أَوْ سَمِنْ سِيزٗنْ فَلْلَنْ بُوُمَرُ وَلْلُنُ سَا 1995-96 لَنْ كُرُ كُدِ ، سَ جَرُمِرْ جَغٗرْرَ مَارِيُ لِيمِوْكسْسَ فَلْزَوْسُ أَدَيْدٗ نَزَانَدٗنْ
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: بَتْتِنْدٗ كٗنْ 190 مِرُ كِدُ سُرُ سُمْ غَرِوْوَ أَمِيرِكَيِ سَا 2008 400 دٗنْ كَدَرِنْزٗ دُلَ بِلِيُنْ 2.3 أَ
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: 1950 لَنْ College Of Arts & Sciences , جَامِيَ بَجِنِيَيِدٗ تَمُزٗ كُرُ بَنَمَ مَارَنْتَدِي كُرَمَرُ وَلْلُنُ
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: فٗرْسٗنَرِ أَبُ غٗرَيبْدٗرُ كُنْنُ كُلْجَا سَ لُوَلَلَا وَازٗنَدٗنْ
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: فٗرْسٗنَرِدٗ إِسٗ بَتْتِرُ وَلْلُنُ نغَوُ سُرُدٗنْ فٗرْسٗنَا نجُتْكٗنُتٗ فُدُتٗنَيِنْ نغَوُ أَسْكِرْرَ US يِ غُزَ كُزَنَايِنْ
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: فٗرِدْدٗ شِمَ كَرُوَ مَتٗرَأَ نَشَ نغٗرِمْمَ دُنُوَمَ يَلَأَ فٗتِيَ كُلُو أَتْلَنتِكْيِرُ رِكُدْرُ تٗكٗنَمَوْ كَوْ كُرُ سِتِلَيْتيِ تُنْدٗنَمَنْ ، كُرُ كَرُوَ فٗرِلْمَأَ كُرَ كٗنْ يَكْكٗمِ رُ تٗكٗنَمَ غٗدِ 35 °W يِلَنْ.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: مُتُوَ فُ أَلُنْسُيِدٗ كٗنْدَوْ كٗنْزَرُ تشِدِيَ مُتُ نٗلِفَيِرُ غَسَانَلَنْ سَنْدِيَ كُلْزٗ كُزٗ كٗنَسَرْ غُونُ
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: فِكِتْ جُنِيُدٗ شَ سَلَمْغَدَ نغَوُ حُنْغِرِيَنْ غٗرَنْ فٗرِكْس 2009 يِ دٗنْ
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: سَ 8:46 am كلْكَلْلَنْ بٗرْنِدٗ سَمْمَسُرُ نٗمْكٗمْلاَ كَرَا ، لُكْتٗدُ مَارَ بُرُ سَلَكْكِدٗ نَ نغَنْزَزٗنَرُ غَانَدٗ رُجِنْلَنْ
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: كُنْنُوَ إنْدِ بِنِ فَرَيْ سَمِرُ وَسْكَتَرُ تٗدٗنَ
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: تشِدَ غَرْيِ نَدٗنْ لِتٗ سٗدِنْنَ كَرَ غَرْرَ بٗرِنْ كُرُ سَمِرُ تشِزَنَ أُيِ ، دَْدِ لِنٗمْ أَرِيأَ نَ تُسُيِأَ دَوْدٗنْ مبِيْ
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: برسكرمPBS يى دو نشورم عيمي ألم دوذم إندي كلا ياي كرو كسونذو يى غنا دول سيسميى روجس يى ماشي.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: .سرو ككد يى لنموضوء فل غوتيكلادن حورر غدي غدي تن بينتورو
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: موسن اندرىرو ككديادوني سنديى مزاكرازين م غلتين.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: جون غرنت دبلو أن إي دي بي كريا مضبي وؤنو (فتو دوني كرابي كرماما بي) كرا كرماماي دلي رو دليل كربي سكرينا كري كروبي فرسكرم ض دولي رو كرسض كتو غونم كري ض.
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: أم لا سوا حتي جون غرانت كنتين رو كنغنا ضونى سندرو سدنما غوزنا كرو علم فرسكرم تيبى بي ضيى بنزو أوؤ دا دريرم رو سودنا.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: كَرُوَدٗ ، مِلْ 645 (1040 km) فٗتِ كٗرْتَا كِفْ بَرْدِيِدٗنْ كَرُ، كُرُ كَوْ تشِدِلَا لِجِنْدٗرُ تَرْتِنْرُ تٗمَتٗنَ، إِلْمُو كٗنْدَارَمْ دِنَيِ أَدُ
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: فٗرِدْدٗ كٗرْمَارُ كَرُوَنْزٗ لِتٗ مِلْ 105 (165km/h) أَوَوْيُنْ لِجِنْمَ مبِيْ كُرُ َلَ فٗتِزٗنَرُ لِتٗ سٗدِنْ
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: فٗرِدْدٗ شِمَ كَرُوَ مَتٗرَأَ نَشَ نغٗرِمْمَ دُنُوَمَ يَلَأَ فٗتِيَ كُلُو أَتْلَنتِكْيِرُ رِكُدْرُ تٗكٗنَمَوْ كَوْ كُرُ سِتِلَيْتيِ تُنْدٗنَمَنْ ، كُرُ كَرُوَ فٗرِلْمَأَ كُرَ كٗنْ يَكْكٗمِ رُ تٗكٗنَمَ غٗدِ 35 °W يِلَنْ
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: كٗنْتَوْ سِبْتِمْبَ كَوُنْزٗ 24, سَا 1759 لَنْ أَتُ غِنِسْيِ سَا 9000 رُ سِتْ جِمْس غِتْ بٗرِوُرِ رُ مُكْكُ تشِكُ دُبْلِنْ أَيْلَنْلَنْ
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: نغَوُ سَا 250 لَنْ ، غَنِسْدٗ كَسُو دِنَيِدُ سَا وُسُنْ يُورُ بِلِيُنْ 10 (US$14.7 بِلِيُنْ) كَلَكْسِنْرُ وُرَزٗ وَلْزٗنَ
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, دٗرِبَ فَلْ كَرَفْكَ A1GP New Zealand يِدٗ كُرُ تَرِحِ كُكْسٗنَ كٗلَ كُتُرُو Auckland Harbour يِ سَا 48 نَدٗنْ نٗمْدَيْ شِيِيْ بَلَنْ كٗرِزٗ كُزٗنَدٗنْ
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mr Reid يِ كَسَدٗ سٗدٗ مُتُ New Zealand يِ A1GP شِرُ Black Beauty سَيِنْدٗ كَسُ 160Km/h لَنْ غَدِغَدِ تُلُرْرُ كُتُرُدٗنْ كٗرِيُنُ
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: دَلِيَ New Zealand يِ نٗمْ دَيْ Mr Reid أُنْزَ نٗمْدَيْ نغَلْتَيِلَنْ نغَلْتٗ سَنْدِرُ كَزِيْيَرُ وَلْلُنُ دَلِلْ تشِدِيَتٗ Black Beauty يِلَنْ ، كُرُ لُكْتُ فَلْ كَسُنْزٗ نغَلْزَنَدٗ شِمَ سَ كَسُنْزٗ 160 Km/hr رُ فُلُزٗنَدٗنْ
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: كٗنْتَوْ 3 كُزٗنَدٗنْ ، أَمْ مُكْكُرُ تٗتَنَ 80 مَ كُزٗنَ تشِدَرَمْ Central Booking يِلَنْ كُلْزَ سَنْدِيَ نٗمْدِ أَفْفِيِمَنْ زُرْتٗيِرُ
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: كٗنْتَوْ إِفٗرِلْ سَا أَدِيلَنْ ، أَمَرِ تشِدَ رُوتٗيِ لُكْتٗ غَنَلَايِ شَرَ غٗلِنْ يِ تشِدَرَمْدٗرُ سِكٗنَ، أَمْ أَوَ 24 أَ كُزٗنَرُ رُوتٗنَ كُرُ شَرَرَمْرُ سَنْدِيَ زُتُو سُنْدَيِدٗ كُلْزَ وُنُ
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: كُمِشِنَدٗ شِمَ بِلْ سٗكْكِنْ، تِنَ مَا، كُرُ تشَجِيَ دَرِ كٗنْتَمَيِ رُوزٗنَدٗ نُوَتَرُ سٗدِنْ. تشَجِيَدٗ دَجِ كُمْفِوْتَ كٗرِيِرُ تٗكِنْ نَ كِسْدٗ تٗدٗنَدٗنْ
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: فُو شَرَيِنْ دَتٗدٗيِ يِمْدُ كَمْ تٗتَنَدٗرُ شَرَ كَمْتِنْدٗ فٗلِجِنْ
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: فِتَ كُسْتِلْلُ ، تٗرِشُرَ أُسْتٗرِلِيَبِ كُرُ كَمْ دُنِ مِنِسْتَ كُرَ لَرْدٗيِ جُنْ حَوَدْيِ نَسَرْجِنْمَ نَفْتٗ كُرَ كَرَفْكَ لِبِرَلْبِدٗ نغَوَنَ كٗنْتَنْزٗ سَنْيَرَمْ كُنْنُ نُكِلِيَبِرُ أُسْتٗرِلِيَ لَنْ تشُنُ
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mr Costello يِ وُنُ سَ كُنْنُ نِوْكِلِيَيِ فَنْدُدٗ مُنْجِنْرُ وَلْجِيَ ، أُسْتٗرِلِيَيِ فَيْدَتٗنْزٗ مَزٗنَمَ نغٗلَوُ
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “سَ كَسُولَرُ وَلْجِيَ أَنْدِ فَنْدِنَمَ نغٗلَوُ . مَانَ ، كُنْنُ نِوْكِلِيَ كَيْدَالَا نَنْكَرُ وَتِمْبَ “ وُنُ Mr Costello يِ
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: غُلْتٗ Ansa يِلَنْ “ دلِيَدٗ أَمْكُرَالَا يَزُيْ حَنْغَلْزَ غُزٗنَ شِدُيْ كٗرِوْ كٗرْمَيْيِ كُرَ غُزٗيِنْمَ
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: دَلِيَيِ Lo Piccolo زَوْرُ كٗجِ سَوُنْزٗدٗ شِمَ مُكْكُ كُمْبُرَمْ Provenzano يِ Palermo لَنْ كُرُ نُتٗنْزٗ كَمْبُدِ سِكْكٗ أَمْكُرَايِ زَوْرُ شَ دَرَجَزَنَ لِتٗرَمْ Provenzano يِ فُتُ مُونْجِنْنُ نغُلْتٗيِدٗ مَزَيْنْرُ ، دِوَلْ كٗرْمَيْزَيِ دُنُوَزَيْن أَدَ
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: أَمْكُرَا أَيْ Provenzano يِ سَ كٗرِوْ رِنِيِيَ كٗرْيِ دِيَيِ يِتَدَزٗنَدٗنْ سَنْدِيَ نُتُ بَدِيُنُ ، كٗرِوْ دُيْ أَمْ مَفِيَيِ Giovanni Falcone أَ Paolo Borsellino أَ 1992 لَنْ تشِزٗنَ دٗ
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: CEO كَمْفَنِ Apple يِ Steve Jobsye نغٗرْوُ دٗرُ زُوَ Iphone دٗأَ لِوْ يَنْغِنْزٗ جِنْسيِنْ سُتُلُ دِنَرُ يِتَغَتْشُو.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: سُرُ مَنَنْزٗ أَوَ 2 يِدٗنْ شِيِ وُنُ “ كُدٗ أَفٗلْيِ وَيَ وَلْتٗ سٗتَنْدِنْ ، أَنْدِي تَرِحِ دِيِنْ كُدٗ”
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brazil دٗ شِمَ لَرْدٗ أَدِنْ Roman Catholic يِ تٗدِنْ زَوْرُ كُرَمَ وُ دِنَلَنْ ، كُرُ تشُتشِ Roman Catholic يِدٗ سَمْبِسُرُ نيِيَ ندِكَتِ جُنْسُ فَلْيِدٗ لَرْدٗدٗنْ كُلْتٗ كٗرِوْجِنْ
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: مَجَلِسْسُ بٗرَزِلْيِدٗ سَا 10 رُ كٗلَ كُلْتٗيِنْ زَافْكَتَ ، كُرُ نيِيَ جِرِ أَيْ كٗرْمَدٗرُ Rio Grande do Sul بَسْ لَنْ كُلْلَتٗ أَوْ شَرَيِ كُلْزٗنَوُ
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: بِلْ بُرُسَلَكْكِدٗ Mayor Sao Paulo يِ بُرُيِ، Marta Suplicy رُوزٗ . شَرَ غُلْتٗنَدٗ ، نغَوُ تَاتٗنَيِنْ ، كٗمَادٗ مُكْكُ Roberto Jefferson يِ
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: زَنْغَزَنْغَوْيِ مُكُ إِكْكُ كَمْ مِلِيُنْ 1.2 يِ سَفْسَ مَجَلِسْسُ لَرْدٗيِرُ حَتٗرُ مَزَينْ كٗنْتَوْ نُفِمْبَيْ لَنْ
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: نغَوُ يَلْلَا كَدَيْ بَنَ شَرَيْ وَنْدِ سَنْدِيَ فَنْزَنْ دُتٗيِرُ مَزَيْنرُ تَوَتْتٗنَيْن ، سَمْنُ كٗنْتَوْ مَاتْش يِ كَوْنزٗ 20 أَ تٗدٗنَ East Bay Community Law Centre لَنْ أَمْ نٗمْ زَلٗمْ فَتُيِ زَمْزٗنَرُ
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: سَ أَمْ آرِ سَدِنْدٗيِ أَوُ سَنْدِيَ سُوَنْدٗنَ غُلْتٗ بَدِزَنَدٗنْ ، يَلْلَا دُ أَوُ دٗيِ زَمْزٗنَ نغُسُيِ إِسَ أَسُوَدَ Carolyn Wilson OHA يِدٗ كُنْغٗنَنْزَ زُ كُرُ بٗلَ كُلْلُنُ.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: أَمْ Lockwood Gardens لَنْ آرِ سَدِنْيِ يَلْلَا 40 أَوْ أَدٗأَ كُزٗنَ سَنْدِيَ فُونْ دُتِنْرُ فَنْزَيْن، دَلِيَ OHA يِ كُلَشِ كٗلَ لٗمَنْنَ فَتُوَيِ غَدِنْ أُكْلَنْد لَنْ سَنْدِرُ أَسُزَنَ دٗنْ، سَنْدِدٗنِ نٗمْ زَلٗمْ فَتُيِ أَدٗ سَنْدِيَ زَمْزٗنَ
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: كَيْيَوْدِ بِكْكِنْزَ كَيَيْ Maui's War Memorial Stadium لَنْ تٗدِنْدٗ حَفْكَدَ، شِدُيْ كَمْ دُو لَارْ 9000 تشَ شَ حَدَرْزَيْندٗ، ، كُرُ سَنْدِيِ كٗرَوْمَنْزَسُرُ كَنَدِ تشُدُ.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: كَمْفَنِ لَمَرْ كَيَوْدٗيِرُ تشِسْسَيْن HK Management Inc. دٗ، دَلِلْ تشِيِ سَ كٗنْتَوْ سِبْتِمْبَيِ كَوُنْزٗ 20 بِكْكِدٗ حَفْسَنَدٗنْ ، أَمْمَ دَلِلْلَ لِتٗيِرُ كٗرْجُ وَزٗنَنْزَا
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: لُيَا غٗرِكْيِسُأَ ، Sakis Kechagioglou George Nikolakopoulos سَنْدِيَ فٗرْسٗنَرِ Korydallus Alhens يِدٗرُ تٗكْكٗنَ، سَنْدِيَ نٗمْ دِي كٗلْتٗأَ نٗمْ زَلِمْمَيِنْ تُوَنْدٗنَلَنْ
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: دَلِلْ أَدِنْ ، أَوْ نُنْغُوَ كُرَ سُرُ كُرْ شَرَيِ غٗرِكْيِلَنْ تٗتَنْغٗنَ تشِدَا شَرَيِ دَفْسٗنَ شَرَسُ، لُيَاسُيِ سُرُ سَا كُزٗنَيِنْ سَدِنْدٗ فٗلَيْتٗمِنْ
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: مَوْوَ غَنَلَا كُزَنَ دٗنْ، نغَوُ حَوَرْدُ حَوَرْمَ Makis Triantafylopoulo فٗرَسْكَرَمْزٗ TV يِنْ “Zoungla” Alpha TV يِدٗنْ بَكْسٗنَدٗنْ، جَمِ مَجَلِسْسُويِ كُرُ لُيَ، Pentros Mantouvalos دٗ شَ دُوُتِ نغَوُ-نغَوُ أَمْ أُفِسْ نزَيْ نٗمْ زَلٗمْلَنْ تشِنْزَارُ فُدٗتٗنَيِنْ
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: أَدَيْمَ شَرَ كُرَ Evangelos Kalousis دٗأَ فٗرْزٗنْرُ تٗكْكٗنَ نغَوُ شَ نٗمْزَلِمْمَ حَلْلَ فَيْدَبَا سٗدِنْ تٗتَنَيِنْ
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Robert يِ سَ شِيِ كَرُنْزٗنْ كٗنٗنْغَ بَدِتٗنَدٗ غُلْتٗرُ وَانُ، كُرُ زَوْرُ فَيْدَا سُرُ فِتٗيِ كٗلَنْ مَنَتِنْمَا، شِيِ وُنُ كٗلَ لَمَرْرَ لَايِنْ مَنَتٗدٗ كَلْكَلْغٗنْيِ
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: شِيِ أَدٗغَيْمَ ، مَنَنْزٗ بُرُيِ Roe v. Wade شِمَ “ شَرَ تشِدٗ دٗيِ دَتٗنَمَ ” يِدٗ وَلْتٗ كَلَكْتشُ ، فَيْدَ شَرَا شَرَرَمْ Supreme Court يِ أَمْرُ غُلْزٗيِنْ لَنْ
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: شِيِ كُرُ حَكْكُ لَمَرْرَنٗمْ أَشِرْتٗغِيِ غُلْتِنْ مَدِيِ كَسَتْسَنَ تَوَدٗأَ تشُنُ ، شِ دُنِ شَوَرِ Roe يِدٗ تُنْغَتٗنَدٗ
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: مَرُتشِدُرِ دٗ كٗلَ دَالْ دٗيِنْ بَ تَمُزٗنَ ، نُوسَ دٗنِ كٗنْ إِنْدِمِرُ إِسٗنَ دٗأَ كُرُ أَرَكْكٗ لَنْ كُونُ
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: نَشَوَ إِنْدِدٗ سِمِ فَيْنَلْ كُرَدٗنْ كٗلَ كٗلْزَيِنْ نَ دُنِ نُوسَيِرُ كُرُ مِنْتِلُنْ لَنْ كٗنَسَرْوُدٗأَ سُوُسٗ 11 كُجِنْ
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: مَرُوتشِدُورِ دَجِ كَبُلْتُرِأَ بِكْكِ فَيْنَلْيِ بَدِيَرَمْبِدٗنْ جُوُ
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: حِسْفِرُونِتشُسْ إِلِزَبِيتِدٗ جِرِ فَلْ يَلْلَ دٗرُمَيُسَوْرِدَيْ كُرُ شِدٗ دُرْ بِلُسِرَفْتُبِ
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: نُغُدُ بَرَ دِيُمَ تِيْنزٗ سَمْمَ كُنْدٗلِيِ زَكْسٗنَ ، بُ زٗمْزٗمْأَ أَدٗ شِ إِنْدِلَنْ دَتٗنْزٗرُ لِجِنْ كُرَ فٗرَمِنْزٗ كُرُوكُرُو جِرِ بِلُسِرَفْتُيِدَيْ.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: فٗرَمِنْزٗ كٗنْ إِنْدِمِدٗ شِمَ كُرَوُ دَجِ أَدٗلَنْ سُ حِسْفِرُونِتشُسْدٗ تشُوَنْدُ ، شِ دُنِ مَانَنْزٗ “ فٗرَمِ فٗتِيِ”
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: كَنْكَرَ زَوْرُ نغُدٗ نغَوُمَنْ ، كٗنْدَارَمْ دُنْيَبِ زَوْرُ زَوْدٗيِ نغُنُووَ أَمْمَ تُلُيِدٗرُ تَكْكَلْ سٗكْكِنْ
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: فِتْمَنْيِ كٗنْدَا أَيْ نغَلَوْجِمْبَ سَيْ سُرُ مَغٗ فُوبِلَنْ وُنُ
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: كَنْكَرَدٗيِ نٗمْ نغُونْزٗأَ نٗمْ غٗدٗدٗفْ نزٗأَ ، غُلْتٗ فِتْمَنْيِنْ ، زَوْرُ أَدٗغَيْرُ دِوِرُ وَلْزٗيِ سَا 15 كُزٗنَدٗنْ
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: غرو كمدو كمى لن حورر تران كلا شتر جف وبين يى أم يكى سرو لار دن اوؤ دون سوندندو ما، وكتو دونى مارنتارو كننو فزين يم كنتو مارس بي كانزو ٢١ لن.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: شدوؤ ديى بين شللا كلا أوؤ دون وأزنا دين سدنا.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: أتن ياى إلمنزو كلادن مبيجى مدى مىنيابولس ستا تريبن رو.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: سندرو حوم كمان أو أوؤ دون شدوو نا تدا دىرو ساتنا م فنتن عم كرمارؤ كلادن شراء بدزنا.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: كُرُ Lodin يِ وُنُ حُكُمَايِ شَوَرِ كَمْزَ كٗلَ أَمْ أَفْغَنِسْتَنْيِ كَرْنُ دُنِ فُولَنْ دَفْسَ وَنْدِ فِتٗنَ غَدِ سَنْدِرُ سُودِنيِ
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: أَمْمَ غُمْنَتِيَ وَكِلْتُويِ وَدَ تُسْكَ نغُو سُرُنَ سُرُ غُمْنَتِ أَفْغَنِسْتَنْ يِنْ دِلِلْدُ سٗكٗ كَرْنُ دَا تٗدِنْبَدٗ
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: أَدٗيِ سٗكٗ حَوَرْ بُرُيِدَا غَنَ غَدِزٗنَ ، تشَمَنْ كَيِدَا شِ كَرْنُ دَفْتِدٗ بَوُ
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: مَارَدٗ Irkutsk نغَنْزَزٗنَ كُرُ أَسْكٗرْرَ سُرُيِ شَ سُنُتِنْ
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: كُلَشِ كٗلَدٗنْ بَدِتٗنَ
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: شِ II-76 دٗ نَشَ أَسْكٗرْرَ رُوشِيَا سُفِيِتْ يِيَ لَنْ ، تٗنْ 1970 لَنْ ، كُرُ تَجِرْوَ كُرُ شَ سُونْدٗنَ رُشِيَلَنْ كٗنْتَوْ كٗزٗنَدٗنْ
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: يِمْ أُكْتُبَ 7 أَ ، إِنْجِنْ لَا تِي مَارَيِنْ تشُلُو تشِتٗكَلْلِنْ أَمْمَ ندُمَ زَوْ فَنْزٗيِ ، رُشِيَيِ تٗنْ لُكْتٗدِنْ شِ II-76 دَا زَكْكُنُ.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: أَلَمَ مِلْ 800 Trans-Alaska Pipeline System دٗ زَكْتٗنَ كٗلَ أَسَرْ كٗنْدَوْ Crude Oil بِنْ فُتُلَامِنْ سٗكٗ كٗنْدَوْ فَلَلَانُ بَتَوْ Fort Greenly Pump Station كٗنْ لَارْمِ دٗنْ
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: كُنْنُدٗ بَنْنَتٗ فَنْدُرَمْمِنْ فُتُ بُرُيِدٗرُ نغٗنْيِ، دَجِ سَوَنْدُ كٗنْدَوْ كُرُدْ أُيِلْ دٗ فُتُلَامِنْ سَكٗ أُبَفُلُ سٗدٗ بُتُ فُتْ غٗرِنْلِ فُمْف سٗتِشُنْ 9 يِنْ
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: دَجِ كَتَ بَلْب بِدٗ أَوُدٗ غَنَرُ كَتٗ دُنُوَارُ تشٗلُ كُرُ كٗنْدَوْدٗ فَدْلَنْ تَنْكٗرُ فَلَلَانُ شِدُنِ بَرِلْ 55,000 رُوجِنْمَ ( غَلَنْ مِلُِنْ 2.3)
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: يِمْ لَرَفَا كَوْسُنْ كُنْتِنْ ، بِنْتس تَنْكٗ دِيدٗ كُوَامِسُنْ سَكْتشِنْ زَكْتٗرَمْ تَنْكٗبِدِٗنْ Thermal Expansion سُرُ تَنْكٗبِدٗ
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Secondary Containment غَدِ فٗرْتٗ تَنْكبِ دٗنْ دُنُنْزٗ رَكْسٗ 104,500 بَرِلْ رُتٗنيِ مبِجِ ، أَمْمَ كُوَسُنْ فُتُ مَتِنْنُ سٗمْبٗرِي
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: زَوَا دُنِ نغَوُدٗ زَانَدٗ فَتُ تَلْبِجِنْيِنْ، شِمَ بُرُ حَوُلْلَنِنْ أَمْكُرَ لَرْدٗ إِرَنْنِنْ أَلُ كٗلَ إِلْلَ فُمْ دٗيِنْ مَنَزَنَ
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: سُرُدٗنْ أَوَا كُنْغٗنَا لِزٗنَدٗ دَفْتٗنَ كُرُسُنْ كَرَفْكُ يُرُفِيُنْ يُنِيُنْ أَوُ كِنْدَوْوَ لِزٗنَ تِمْبَ ، أَوُ دُنِ كُرُ شِدٗمِنْ غُمْنَتِ إِنْيِ تشِ فِسْكُ 80 رَزٗأَ لَرْدٗ دِيَبِ نزٗ غَيِنْ
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: سُرُ زَوَا كَرِنْغٗ أَلْلُ سَتُلُنَدٗ ، OPEC يِ وُنُ زَوْرُ لَمَرْ كٗنْدَوْبِ أَدٗ نغَوُزٗنَ سَا فِنْدِ نغَوُيِ أَلْلَنْ بَرِلْ مِلِيُنْ 2.8 بَسْ كَوْ فَلْلِنْ
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: لَرْدٗبِ كُرَنْزٗ أَيَتُ الْلهِ عَلِي خَمِينِي لَمَرْ زَوْرُ كٗنْدَوْ أَلْلُ كٗرْتَدٗ كِلْ تُتَارُ زَنْجُ ، كََوْ لُكْتٗ كَرَفْكَ حَكْكِرُ مبِلْتٗمَ شِدُنِ IRAN ISLAMIC REVOLUTION يِنْ بُتِنْ دٗ سَا 1979 ,كُرُ أَوُلَا كٗلَدٗنْ تٗدٗ لَمَرْ كٗنْدَوْبِ بَسْ غِيَيْ أَلْلَنْ سُلُ
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: مَارَ دٗ سِدِ كَدُزٗ سُرُ فُويِرُ كَرَا، سَ 5 am يِرُ تٗمَتٗنَ (لُكْتُ غٗدِي ) ،أَوُ نُرْ كُنْنُبِ كَلِفُنِيَ يَلَبِ ، أُرِغُنْنَ، نِبَدَأَ، كُرُ أُتَرَنْ تُرِنْ
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: مَارَ دٗ شِلْلِوْوَ سَمٗنْ سَمِ فُويِنْ
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: كُرُ مَارَدٗ أَلَمَ كِلُمِتَ 12.8 أَوْ 8 مِلْ أُسْكُيِدِيْ كَسُنْ سُوشِنْ سَنْ فٗرَنْسِسْكُنْ غُنِ لُسْ أَنْجِلْس رُ مِنْتِ فَلْلِنْ لِجِنْ.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: مَارَ سٗتَدُسْ بِ تَرِحِ كُرَ غٗنَجِنْ كٗلَ شِمَ مَارَ بُرُيِ دِنَرُ وَلْتٗنَمَ، أَوُلَا كٗنْتَوْ مِيْ 1969 نٗمْ غُنِي بُرُبِ كُكْسٗنَ نُتٗيِ تٗنْ كَوْ مَارَ أَفُولُ إِكْس كُمَنْد مُدِلْ دٗ وَلْتِنْنُ
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: تشِ نجِيِ فٗتِيِ يَلَ كَلِفُنِيَ مِدٗنْ كَمْزٗ كُجِنْ كُرُ سَمِدٗ نُرْرَرُ سٗدِنْ كَلِفُنِيَلَنْ تَيْ دَوْ أُرِغُنْيِمِنْ كُرُ نِبَدَا إِدَحُأَمِنْ كُزٗ أُتَرُ إِشِنْ “ تُمْ دُكْسبُرِ تشِسْتٗغٗمَ تشِدَ سٗتَدُسْت يِ وُنُ
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Mr. رُدْ بِ شَوَرِنْزٗ نِزَمْ Kyoto Climate Record رُ مُسْكُ يَكُدٗ أَمِرِكَا سُرُنْ سُتُلِنْ، أَدِ سَوْن سَنْدِمَ لَرْدٗ دُنِ فُوزَنَ بَسْ مُسْكُ سَكٗيِمَ
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: غُمْنَتِ نغَلَوْ أُسْتٗرُلِيَبِ دِنَدٗ نِزَمْ Kyoto دٗرُ مُسْكُ يَكُ وَانُ، سَنْدِيِ غُلْزَيِنْ زَزٗنْزَ بَنْنَجِنْ ، شِيِ كُرُ كٗنْدَوْ Coal لَرْدٗ دِيَبِرُ تُلُودٗ لِزٗنَ، لَرْدٗأَ إِنْدِيَسُ تشَيْنَسُدٗ سَنْدِيَ تُلُودٗ نغَنْزَتٗيِ
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: شَادٗ شِمَ كٗنْغَنْتِ كُرَوُ سُرُ تَرِحِنْزٗيِنْ
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: كَمْفَنِدٗ رِوَانْزٗ نغُزِيْيَ مَجِنْ كُرُ سَنْدِيَ نَشَا دٗنْ نُتٗ نَدُنِ Skype بِ دَرَجَ كُرَ زَانْتٗنَدٗنْ ،أَلَمَنْنَ نَشَا تشَيْنَسُ، غٗدِ يُورُفْ يِسُ بٗرَزِلْ س
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: إِلْمُويِ زَنْزَنَ شِ Enceladus دٗ شِ نَشَا إِلْمُ Geology يِنْ تشِدَجِنْ كُرُ Saturn's icy E ring لَنْ شَ تُونْدُ
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Enceladus دٗ زَوْرُ أَوُ نُرْ كَلَكْتشِنْمَ سُرُ نَزَمْ دُنْيَبِنْ ، كُرُ أَلَمَ كَشِ 90 نُرْ كٗنْغَلْيِ كَلَكْسِنْ
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: بِسْكِ تَنْدُمَ زَمَنْنِ Konami دٗ كَكَدِ كَوَرْيِنْ وُنُ نَادَا كَوْ أَرَكْكٗأَ بِسْكِ بٗرِنْسَرْ سُتُلِنْ كٗلَ Fallujah يِنْ
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: شِ بِسْكِدٗ كٗلَ كٗرِوْ Fallujah كٗنْ إِنْدِمِ ، كٗرِوْوَ دُنُوَ كَتِ أَسْكٗرْرَ أَمِرِكَيِأَ إِرَنْنَايِ
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: ACMA يِ كُرُ أَسُزٗنَ، بِدِيُدٗ نغَوُ إِنْتَنِتْتِنْ فٗلِتِنْدٗنْ ، Big Brother دٗ كَيِدَا Online Content Sensorship يِ فَرْزٗ كُزٗيِ كُرُ أَوُ غُتٗنَدٗ وِبْسَيْت زَنْ غٗنَتِي
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: فَتُ حَوَرْرَيِ كٗنْدَارَمْسُأَ بَيَنْزٗنَ كٗلَ كَيِدَا لَمَرْرَ إِنْتَنِتْ يِ ، ندَسُمَنْ نيَيِ سَنْدِيَ كَشِمُ إِنْتَنِتْ يِرُ غُتِنْ ، كُرُ زَهِرْرُ كٗلَ سَبَ دٗيِنْ نَفْتٗدٗ مبُ
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: تشِدَرَمْ تشِمَيِ أَمِرِكَيِ دُنِ نَيْرُبِ لَنْ دَانَ دٗ ، نزٗرْتَرِوْمَسُ لَرْدٗ سُمَلِيَيِدٗ دَوَرِ بُمْ يَكُيِ سَدِنْرُ كِنْيَيِ بَرِزٗنَ، دَوَرِ بُمْ يَكُيِ كِنْيَا إِتُفِيَارُ
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: أَمِرِكَيِ غُلْزٗنَ كٗلَ حَوَرْرَ فَنْزٗنَ نَشَ لَانْ كُرُ دَتٗ بَارُ فَيْدَ دُنِ بُمْ نَدُنِ “نَا سُوَ” دٗرُ بُمْ سَكِنْ بٗلَ إِتُفِيَا كِنْيَا لَنْ
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: كَوْ دِ دِيلِ شُوَ دِ كُوبَتْ رِفُتْ أَ، حِكْأَ جُنْسُنْأَ أَوْلَا لٗفْسَيْن حَوَرْرَ سَمِنْجِنْمَ - أَوْ حَوَرْ كٗرَتِنْدٗأَ- لُكْتٗ دُنِ سَنْدِ فُورَا مَرَنْتَيِ UW يِ سَا 1988 دٗنْ
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: نغَوُ بَدِتٗنَيِنْ، شِ أُنِيُنْدٗ بَحَوَرْ تَوَتْكَتَرُ وَلْزٗنَ سُرُ حَوَرْرَ سَمُنْزٗنَيِلَنْ ، كُرُ إِدِشُنْ بَكْسَيْنْمَ مبِجِ ، وِبْسَيتْ أَمْ مِلِيُنْ 5000000 يِ غَسَانَ كٗنْتَوْ أُكْتُبَيِنْ ، تَلْلَا ،حَوَرْ أَوَ 24 يِ ، فُدْكَسْتْ أَ كُرْتَ كَرٗنْغٗيِ دُنْيَرُ تُتُلُنَ دُنِ أَتْلَسْ دٗ شِدُنِ أَوَ دُمْب وُلْد يِنْ بُوتٗنَدٗ
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: أَلْغُرِيَ جِنِرَلْ تُمِ فٗرَنْكسْ أَ يِمْلَانْ كٗلَ حَوَرْرَنْزَ كٗجِ كٗجِيِ غَزَبٗنْ ( غُورسْ دٗ شِيَ سَنْدِ أُنِيُنْ يِ حَوَرْرَ تشِنَ شَ تِفَأَ لُكْتُ دُنِ جِمَإِ نغَلْوُ دِنَنْزَيِ سَدِنْلَنْ نغَوُ 2000 كَرْنُ مُونْتِيِ شَ غٗفْتٗنَدٗنْ
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: حَوَرْ رُوتُو كَدَيِ دُنُوَ كَسَدٗأَ سُونْدٗنَ كٗلَ Jon Stewart أَ Stephen Colberts أَ حَوَرْ كٗلَ رُكِيِِ فٗلِزٗنَ
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: شِ فَرَسْكٗرَمْ أَرْتِسْتِكْ يِ دٗ سُرُ كَمْفِنْيِلَنْ مبِجِ نَدُنِ بُتشَرِسْت سِتِ حُلْ دُنِ رِلُنْتش مٗرَدٗزٗنَ كٗلَ فُتُوَ دُنِ رُمَنِيَنْ كَفِتَلْ نُوَتَ دُ شَ كَفِتَلْ كُلُفُلْ مِتْرُفُلِسْ لَنْ نُوَتَ دٗ
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: بٗلَدٗ شِمَ بُرُُ وَلْجِنْ نَشَ سَوْت إِسْتَنْ يُرُفْ لَنْ كَوْفَرِدِ دَ كٗنٗنْغَتٗرُ ، دِنَيِ كُرَنْزٗ يَمَيِ أَتْ كٗنٗنْغَتٗيِدٗ ، كَتِكَتِ كٗنْتَوْ جُنْأَ أُغُسْ سَا أَدٗيِ لَنْ
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: وُرْمَتٗ كُيِدٗ نَزٗنَ نَشَ لَمَرْرَ كُنْدُتُ غُمْنَتِيَيِ تٗدٗنَ سُرُ كٗنْتَوْ مَتْش سَا أَدٗيِ كٗلَ كٗرَوْ أَوَاغَدِ غُتُرُ
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: نزٗرَيْ 300 يِدٗ سُدُنَ أَدُدُ دُنِ 1300 كَر ِيِجْ يِ دُنِ تُوُنْدِنْ نٗنْ كُرُ نٗمْ نغُ أَمْسُيْيِ غَنَجِنْ
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: كٗرِستوفَ غَرْسِييا، مَنَمَ فَيلْلَ دَلَيوَ بي لوس اَنْجِلِسْ بَي دٗ ي ووْنو كَم دونِ تٗمَتٗنَ دٗ تشِدِ اَمْمَ رو اَمَرِ بَ روْ غاوو نَنْكَرو كُلَسْتِنْ نَمْنٗمْ غاوو نَنْكَ رو غٗنيِ
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: اَلَمَ دٗ زَحِر رو بَنْنَتٗنيِ; نْزَسَ دٗ تَربُلِنْ سٗلٗمْ بي دونِ اَلَمَ نٗلَيوَ بيْءَ كَرُوُ بيْءَ لَنْ زَيَيْتٗنَ دٗنْ تشَيدوْ “اوو” دٗءَ “اِي” رو فَلْتٗ نَنْكَ روْ.
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: أَوُ شِرُ رِدْ تَيْد غُلْتِنْدٗ نٗمْ نغُو كَرِنِيَ بٗرِبِسْيِ غَنَلَا نُأَتَأَ كُزٗنَ شَ سُوُدِنْ ، كَرِنِيَ بٗرِبِسْدٗ أَلَا سِلْ فَلْلَ
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: لَمَرْرَ أَلَغْلَبِ مبِجِ سَنْدِ دُنِ ندِكَتِدٗرُ غَسَا كٗنْدَارَمْ أَلْغَيْ دٗرُ كٗجِمَا سَنْدِيَ سٗكْكٗ نغُوزَيْنمَ سٗدِنْ
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: أَلْغَيْ شِمَ دٗ أَوُلَا تِنْزٗنْ نِوْرُ تُغْزِنْ غُلْتِنْ سُتُلِنْ مبِجِ شِدُنِ تشَوْ كَمْمِأَ بٗنِيِأَ إِنْدِسُ تشِجِنْمَ
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: بٗنْيِ سُدٗ نغُورُ سُسُنِنْ دَلِلْ نٗمْ نغُو سُمْدٗيِ سُرُ نجِدٗيِنْ
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: أَدَمْمَنَسُأَ زَمْجِنْ سَ نجِ لِتٗنَ دُنِ كَرُوَا تشَمْبَاْتٗ نجِبِأَيِ غُزٗنَ يِنْزَيْيَ.
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: سَا زَوْرُ دُنُأَدٗنْ ، كَرُوَ شِرُ تٗرُفِكَلْ سَيْكٗلُنْ غُنُ سَيِنْدٗ ، شِدُنِ تٗلَمْ مَلْدِبْس بِ لَنْ مَانَنْزٗ بُوُ بُدُ دِفِنُبِدٗ ، كَسُ كِلُمِتَ 240 سُرُ أَوَ فَلْلِنْ (مِلْ 149أَوَ فَلْيِنْ )مَ نُزٗغٗنَ
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: كُدَتِرُ ، كَرُوَدٗ لِتٗ 83 Km/h يِدَيْ ، كُرُ دُنُنْزٗ فُلُتِنْنُ تٗمَتٗنَ
text_en: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.

text: يِمْ لَرَفَا،كَرَبهكَ دِكْكِلْ بَسْكِتْ بَال يِ يُنَيْتِيدْ ستِيتْ يِ دَلِلْ كُوبِدْ 19 يِرُو بِكْكِوَنزَ رُووَنُو
text_en: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19.

text: شَوَرِ كَرَبْكَ دٗيِ أَدٗ نغَوُو كَيْيَمَ جَازْ لَنْ كُلِ كوَاسُوَ كُوبِدْ-19 يِ شَا سٗتَنَيِنْ غُوَاتٗ
text_en: The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.

text: فُوسْسِلْ أَدٗرُو وُتٗيْيَ، مَانَنزٗ يَكْتٗ أَدٗ فُتُ شَدَ مُولِكُلَايْ تٗمَزٗنَآ كُوزٗنَرُو دَتِنْ وَكَوُنُو
text_en: "Based on this fossil, that means the split is much earlier than has been anticipated by the molecular evidence.

text: أَدٗيِ مَآنَنْزٗ دٗ أَفْفِسُو كَلَكْتٗ غٗنَتِنْ، كُلَشِمَ وِيفِي بَالِي رِسَاتشْ سَابِسْ إِتُوفِيَايْ كُرُ لٗبْتٗمَ كَرَآدٗيِ فَلْ،بِرْحَانِ أَسْفَوْ يِ وُونُو
text_en: That means everything has to be put back," said researcher at the Rift Valley Research Service in Ethiopia and a co-author of the study, Berhane Asfaw.

text: كٗمَآرُو كُدِي إِي أُوْ إِيْلْ دٗ سُوَنْدٗ كَسُوُ أَيْ إِيْمْ بيَا حَنْغَلْنزٗنْ فُوُزٗغٗزَ يُنَيْتغيدْ ستِيتْ لَنْ زَوْرُو فَيْدَتِنْ دٗيِ سٗكٗ
text_en: Until now, AOL has been able to move and develop the IM market at its own pace, due to its widespread use within the United States.

text: فَسَلْ أَدٗ نٗمْكَمْبِي أَدٗ وَنَيْ دَجِنه
text_en: With this arrangement in place, this freedom might end.

text: أَمْ يَاحُوُ يِ، مَيْكرُوسُوفْتْتَ، فَيْدَتَيْنْدٗ، لُوَيَوْ إِيْ أُو إِيلْ بيَا كِيمِ رُو وَلْزَيْنْ
text_en: The number of users of the Yahoo! and Microsoft services combined will rival the number of AOL's customers.

text: نُوزَنْ رُوكْ بَنكْ دٗ سَآ 2008 لَنْ لَرْدٗيِرُو تٗدٗنَ نغَوْ كَمْفَنِدٗ بَنَ دُوَسَشِبِي نَ غُومْنَتِ يُوْكِي لَنْ سُوَنْدٗنَرُو أَسُتُنَ لَنْ
text_en: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.

text: نُوزَنْ رُوكْ دٗ بَنَا مَانُو دَلِلْ فِتٗنَ سُوبْفٗرَيْمْ مُوتِيجْ سَآ 2007 يِدٗ شَا زَمْزٗنَ يِنْ
text_en: Northern Rock had required support due to its exposure during the subprime mortgage crisis in 2007.

text: سَ. رَِتْ؟بٗرَنْسَنْ بجِنْ غٗرُبْنزۧدٗ بِتْ بَنْكٗ؟دٗيَ وَنَوْ كَوْ بَنْكٗدٗ كَدۧيَرَ تَدِنْرَ
text_en: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group had a bid for the bank rejected prior to the bank’s nationalisation.

text: سَاْ 2010 بِلَنْ، سَ لَرْدٗيَرَ تٗدٗنَدٗنْ بَنْكٗ هَيِسٗتٗرِتْ كٗمَيَ نَدَنْ رَكْ فِأَلْسِ دٗ “بَنْك بَتْتِ” نَدَنْ رَكْدٗنْ يَكٗكَتٗ (أَسَتْ مَنَجِمَنْت)
text_en: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

text: بَجِنْدٗ بَنْكٗلَ؟نَدَنْ رَكْبِدٗ بَسْ لَوَ، كَمْفَنِ أَسْسَتْ مَنجْمَنْبِدٗ غٗنْيِ
text_en: Virgin have only purchased the ‘good bank’ of Northern Rock, not the asset management company.

text: أَدٗ شِمَ لَكْتُ كٗنْ أَُوُمَرَ كَسَتْتٗنَوَ سُرَ تَرُهِبَلَنْأَمْسَيَ لَاْ كِمِيَمَنْ مَسْبِرَ تَوَتْسَنَ أِسٗ ظُنْيَنْدۧ أَتْرَ سُكْكُرُنَ مَوَ
text_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.

text: سُرَ سٗلْلَوُِوَ 24,000 رَتْرَ سَكْكُرُنَيَنْ، 34 يَدَيْ بَأَ دُنْيَ مَسْيَنْ كَشَرَوْ تَوَتْتٗغٗنَ
text_en: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.

text: سُرَ كَوُوَ أَنْيِبَنْ مِيَوْنْدٗ شِلْلَوُوَ أَوْ كَلْوُو كُمْتَ شِِرَ كٗنْتَغٗ جُلَيْبَ كَزٗنَدٗنْ سَكْكُرُنُ دٗنْ كَشَ
text_en: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.

text: كَوُوَ أَنْيِيَ لَاْنزَدٗ، دُنْيَبَ دُوُنْ تُوَنْدِمْبَ، سَنْدِيَ دَلَ يُأَيْب $11,000 لَنْ سٗتَ $22,500 رَ سَاْدٗن رَ أَوُنْس وَسَ تٗلدِنْ، تَمَنْ دِنَرْبَأَ غَدَغَد مِوَنْ كَزٗنَ.
text_en: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

text: نغَوَ غَسكَ كَسَبَدٗ كَزٗنْيَنْ، كَسْلَوِسْكِدٗ ِمَ دٗرَوَسْ َم َشَمْغِيَنْشِبْ لِزدَوَ كُوَيَيَ كَرَ 2,250أَ
text_en: Following the race, Keselowski remains the Drivers' Championship leader with 2,250 points.

text: كَرَ تُلُرْلَنْ نغَوَدٗ؟زٗغَيِنْ، جَنْسَنْ كٗنْ أِنْدِمَرَ كَدَ كُرُ 2,243
text_en: Seven points behind, Johnson is second with 2,243.

text: كۧنْ؟يَكْكَمِ، كَرَ زَلَنْ نغَوَنْزٗ؟زَغَيِنْ، أَمْمَ؟أُوُ لَنْ بَيَرْأَ كَوَنَ، كَهْنَأَ، تٗرِوُكْس. جِنِيَأَ كٗنْ أُوُمِأَ أَرَكْكٗمِأَرَ كَشَ كَرَ 2,220۔أَ 2,207۔أَ لَنْ
text_en: In third, Hamlin is twenty points behind, but five ahead of Bowyer. Kahne and Truex, Jr. are fifth and sixth respectively with 2,220 and 2,207 points.

text: سٗتِوُتْأَ غَرْدَنْأَ، كَنْسَتْ َ، كُرُ هَرْبَكْ أَدٗ نَأَ مَيَوْ بُرَيَدٗنْ دٗرَيُبْ؟شَمْفِيَنْشِبْ بَدٗنْ غَسْكَ كَسَبَ دِيَوْ غَبْسٗأَ
text_en: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, and Harvick round out the top-ten positions for the Drivers' Championship with four races remaining in the season.

text: أَسْكٗرْرَ نجِيَ أُسْبَيَ سَنْدِيَ تَجِرْوَدٗ كُلَسْسَيِنْ أَدَ
text_en: The US Navy also said they were investigating the incident.

text: كُرُ سَنْدِيَ مَنَلَنْ غُلْزَنَ، “سِدَرَوُدٗ كٗمَرَ شِدَ سَدِنْ كٗلَ فُتُ مَاْرَ نجِيَ دٗأَ كٗلَوَ سٗلَيْلَنْ تُلَيَنْ”
text_en: They also said in a statement, "The crew is currently working to determine the best method of safely extracting the ship".

text: مَاْرَ نجِيَ سُرَ أَبَنْجَ كٗلَسْ مِنْ كَوْنْتَمَجَسْ شِبْ غُلْتِنْدٗ، كٗلَ زَوَلْنزٗ فُرْتَ فٗرِنْس دَنِ فَلَوَسَنْ دَاْنَ دٗرَ لَتۧ سٗدِنْيَنْ
text_en: An Avenger class mine countermeasures ship, the ship was on its way to Puerto Princesa in Palawan.

text: شِدٗ دَوْ مَاْرَوَ نجِيَ كُفُ كٗنْ تُلُرْمِ أَسْكٗرْرَ نجِيَ أُسْ يَدْنْ كَرَ كُرُ سَسَبَوْ، نَغَسَكِ جَفَنْيَدٗنْ نَنْزَ
text_en: It is assigned to the U.S. Navy’s Seventh Fleet and based in Sasebo, Nagasaki in Japan.

text: أَمْ مُمْبَيْرَ بُتُرُمْ سَوْدٗنَدٗ مَارَ نجِيَ لَنْ كَشَوْ كٗنْتَغٗ نُبَمْبَيَ كَوُنْزٗ 26، سَاْ 2008، رَكْكَنْزَنْ نغُنَتْسَ، بَلِمِيَ زَمَنْبَسَ سَوْدٗنَ كُیرُ نَأَ كَدَ بَكْسَنَ سُرَنْزَنْ تَشَ مَاْرَ ِشِدِيَشَتٗرَبْتِ شَجِيَ أَمْ نغٗوُأَدٗأَ كُرُ أَتَلْ تَجْ مَهَلْبَ سُوَ سُوُنْنَمْ دٗأَ مبَجِ
text_en: The Mumbai attackers arrived via boat on Novemeber 26, 2008, bringing with them grenades, automatic weapons and hit multiple targets including the crowded Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus railway station and the famous Taj Mahal Hotel.

text: دَبِدْ هَتْلَيْبَ أَلْلَمْتٗنْزٗأَ بَيَنْ سَبْتٗنْزٗأَيَ شَدَ أَمْ 10 بُنْدُوَأَ فَكِسْتَنِ مِلِتَنْت غٗرُبْبَ شِرَ لَكْشَأَ تَيْبَ سَيِنْ دٗأَ بَنَزَنَ
text_en: David Headley's scouting and information gathering had helped to enable the operation by the 10 gunmen from the Pakistani militant group Laskhar-e-Taiba.

text: بُتُرَمْ شِمَ دٗيَ نٗمْكَمْ ندِكَتَ لُ أِنْدِيَأَ فَكِسْتَنْإَيَ زَوْرَ نَسْكَنْزٗنَ
text_en: The attack put a huge strain on relations between India and Pakistan.

text_en: The report showed test scores had increased implausibly fast, and alleged the school internally detected problems but didn't act on the findings.

text_en: The International Olympic Committee voted to include the sports at its executive board meeting in Berlin today. Rugby, specifically rugby union, and golf were selected over five other sports to be considered to participate in the Olympics.

text: سُكٗاشْ-أ،كَرَتَيْ- أ كُرُ بِسْكِيْ رٗلْلَ يَيْدِيْ سُرٗو بِسْكِيْ أٗلُمْبِكْ يَيْدِيْرٗو غَوٗ مٗرَدِيْزَنَ دِيِيْ مِسْكِيْ بِيْسْ بٗولْ يَيْا كُرُ سٗفتْ بٗولْ يَيْا دٗوٗ سَ 2005 لَدِينْ بِسْكِيْ أٗلُمْبِكْ يَيْدِنْ كُرِيَ سَنْدِيَ تُلٗوٗ يَيْ سَوَنْدِيْنَ دِيْ يَيْيِرٗو
text_en: Squash, karate and roller sports tried to get onto the Olympic program as well as baseball and softball, which were voted out of the Olympic Games in 2005.

text_en: The vote must still be ratified by the full IOC at it's October meeting in Copenhagen.

text_en: Not all were supportive of the inclusion of the women’s ranks.

text_en: 2004 Olympic silver medallist Amir Khan said, "Deep down I think women shouldn’t fight. That’s my opinion."

text_en: The trial took place at Birmingham Crown Court and concluded on August 3.

text_en: The presenter, who was arrested at the scene, denied the attack and claimed he used the pole to protect himself from bottles being thrown at him by up to thirty people.

text: كْوْنْوْا دُنْوواَ سْلٗمْ– فْتْ تُرِنْبَ دُ شِمَ نْدَرَسْوْ سَمِيْ لَدٗنْ زَكْسٗ
text_en: Dark energy is a completely invisible force that is constantly acting upon the universe.

text_en: Its existence is known only because of its effects on the expansion of the universe.

text: غْوْنْنِيََ نْزُنْدُ يْدٗيِ ألَمَرَمْ تشِدِ يْ كٗمْبَلْ دٗا دٗرِزٗ كٗلْزٗنَ مَ شِرْو لْوبْيْتْ سْكَفْسْ سَنَمَ فْودُزَنَ دٗ شِمَ كٗمْبَلْ دٗا غَنَا–غَنَنْ فَتْسٗيِنْ دٗيْ سَبَبْ وْ تٗمَزَنَ
text_en: Scientists have discovered landforms littered across the moon's surface called lobate scarps that have apparently resulted from the moon's shrinking very slowly.

text: سَنْدِ سْكَفْسْ أَدٗ سْودٗ نَشَ كٗمْبَلْ يْدٗنْ غَنَا– غَنَا مْبِجِيْ، شِمَ لَمَرْ لِتَرَمْ جِيْولْوجِكْ يْدٗيْ سَبَبْ وْ
text_en: These scarps were found all over the moon and appear to be minimally weathered, indicating that the geologic events that created them were fairly recent.

text: كُلَشِ دٗيْ فٗلِْزٗنَ لَمَرْرَ جِوْلوجِكْ يْدٗنْ شِمَ كٗمْبَلْ دٗا سُنْوتِنْ
text_en: This theory contradicts the claim that the moon is completely devoid of geologic activity.

text: كَمْ دُوُ زْورْزَنَ دٗيْ مَتْو شِ يَسْكٗا سُرْودٗنْ بَلِمِيَا سْودٗ كٗرِزٗ دَوْو جَمِيْ يْيْدٗرْو كَرَوْ
text_en: The man allegedly drove a three-wheeled vehicle armed with explosives into a crowd.

text_en: The man suspected of detonating the bomb was detained, after sustaining injuries from the blast.

text: هُوُمَآ سْودٗيِ نْوزَنْيِ يّيْ شِدٗ مْيْمْبَ جِلِ وْغْهُرْ يْدٗو نْوزَنَ
text_en: His name is still unknown to authorities, although they do know he is a member of the Uighur ethnic group.

text: نَدِيَة دُوُ يْمْ كَوْ 17، كٗنْتَوْو سْيْبْتَمْبَرْ سَآ 2007 لَدٗنْ لِيِتَرِي أَلِسْكْ لَرْدٗ رَشَيَا يْدٗنْ رِتٗ مْبْينْ تَمْبٗنَ دٗ نٗمْ– كٗرَوُو فُونْدْسْ 17 وْنْسْ 1 يْيِ سٗتٗنَ
text_en: Nadia, born on September 17, 2007, by Cesarean section at a maternity clinic in Aleisk, Russia, weighed in at a massive 17 pounds 1 ounce.

text_en: "We were all simply in shock," the mother stated.

text_en: When asked what the father said, she answered "He couldn't say a thing - he just stood there blinking."

text_en: "It's going to behave like water. It's transparent just the way water is.

text_en: So if you were standing by the shoreline, you would be able to see down to whatever pebbles or gunk that was on the bottom.

text_en: As far as we know, there is only one planetary body that displays more dynamism than Titan, and its name is Earth," added Stofan.

text: لَمَرْ أدِيْ يِمْ كَوُ 1 كِنْتَوْ جَينْوَرِ يَيْدِيْرٗو بَدِيْيَتٗ يِمْ دٗوٗ جَمِ دُوُ كِيْمْبِيْلِيْمْ إِنْغُرٗو أٗبَنَزَوَ بٗوسْ أٗوفِسْ يَيْدِيْ كَتِنْزَ سَا بِيْلِنْيْ أَدَرَمْ سَلِنَ دِيَا سَوَنْدِنْيِ سَا لَلِيْزَنَ لَدِنْ
text_en: The issue started on January 1st when dozens of local residents started complaining to the Obanazawa Post Office that they hadn't received their traditional and regular New Year cards.

text_en: Yesterday, the post office released their apology to citizens and the media after discovering that the boy had hidden more than 600 postal documents, including 429 New Year postcards, which weren't delivered to their intended recipients.

text: أَوٗ دٗوٗ شِرٗو لُنَرْ أٗبِيتَر تشَنْدِرَيَانْ -1 سَنَ دِيْ كِنْبَلْ مُونْ إِمْبَكْتْ بِرٗبْ سَنَ مَ نَشَ كِنْبَلْ يَيْ أَلَمَ كِيلٗومِتَ 1.5يَيْ دَكِكَوٗسٗنْ (مِيلْ 3000أَوَ وٗسٗنْوْنَ) لَيْجِنْ دِيْ كِنَسَرْتِي بَتَوُ فِيتِا كِيْمبَلْ يَيْدِنْ سُكُرُنَ
text_en: The unmanned lunar orbiter Chandrayaan-1 ejected its Moon Impact Probe (MIP), which hurtled across the surface of the Moon at 1.5 kilometres per second (3000 miles per hour), and successfully crash landed near the Moon's south pole.

text: كَرِيا إِِنْزُنْدُيَيْ يَسْكِيْ دِيْ غُوْتِنْ بُرٗونْ، لُنَرْ بُرٗوبْ دِيَيْ أَلَمَ أَلَمْ لَرْدِي إِنْدِيَ يَيْدِيا نَشَ وٗسٗونْ غٗوزِنَ إِمْبَي
text_en: Besides carrying three important scientific instruments, the lunar probe also carried the image of the Indian national flag, painted on all sides.

text: أَمْ دُوٗ كَمْ سُنْجِنْ يِنْ سُلُوُنَ وُيَيْ أَدِيْرٗو إِنْغَوَنَ- كِينْتَنْزَا سَدِينَ دِيْرٗو أَسْكِرْغِنَ“ سَيْ سِرِبِوٗنْ دِيِيْ سَمْنٗو هَوَرْ مَتُوُ سٗيَيْرٗو غُلْزِيِنْ فَنْتِنَ
text_en: "Thanks for those who supported a convict like me," Siriporn was quoted as saying at a press conference.

text_en: "Some may not agree but I don't care.

text: كَوُ سَا 1947 لَرْدِ بَكِسْتَنْ يَيْدِيْ مُسْكٗو بِرْتَنِيَ (بِرِتِشْ) يَيْدِنْ كِرْمَيْ كِلَيَيْ سَمٗوُنَ لَدِنْ، كُرَ لَرْدِيَيْ دِيْ وَكِلْلَ سِيَسَ يَيْ تشِدَرٗ غٗوزِنَ NATA دِيْا كٗتْتٗ غٗوزَنَ كِرْمَيْ سٗنٗتِنْ
text_en: Since Pakistani independence from British rule in 1947, the Pakistani President has appointed "Political Agents" to govern FATA, who exercise near-complete autonomous control over the areas.

text: سَنْدِ وَكِلْلَ أَدِيْ سَنْدِمَ لَمَرْرَ غٗمْنَتِ يَيْا شَرَ يَيْا سَمْمَ سٗنٗتِنْ فُتُ دُكْسٗر لَرْدِي بَكِسْتَنْ يَيْ سَنَنْزِ كِنْ 247 يَيْ سُوُدِيْنَ يَيْ
text_en: These agents are responsible for providing government and judicial services under Article 247 of the Pakistani Constitution.

text: مَكْكَ دَوُدِ كِيرْمِيسِيلِيمْ بِيْدِنْ أَلَمَ سَا 10 سُوَ يَيْ كُسٗتٗرَمْ لَا وُرْتِنَ
text_en: A hostel collapsed in Mecca, the holy city of Islam at about 10 o'clock this morning local time.

text_en: The hostel's guests were mostly citizens of the United Arab Emirates.

text_en: The death toll is at least 15, a figure which is expected to rise.

text_en: Leonov, also known as "cosmonaut No. 11", was part of the Soviet Union's original team of cosmonauts.

text_en: On March 18, 1965, he performed the first manned extravehicular activity (EVA), or "spacewalk", remaining alone outside the spacecraft for just over twelve minutes.

text: تشِدَنْذٗ أَدٗ نَنْكَرْو شِيْ كَمْبَتٗوُ كُرَمَ شِرْو ` هِرْو أَوفْ دِ سْوفْيْتْ يُنِيْونْ` سَنَمَ كَمْبَتْوُ شِرْو كُرَوْ بَدٗا سٗوَنْدٗنَ.
text_en: He received the "Hero of the Soviet Union", the Soviet Union's highest honor, for his work.

text_en: Ten years later, he led the Soviet part of the Apollo–Soyuz mission symbolizing that the Space Race was over.

text_en: She said, "There is no intelligence to suggest that an attack is expected imminently.

text_en: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.

text_en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text_en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text_en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: ثِمَا كُومَينْ فَوُنْضشِنْ يِي لْيسْلِى ؤنْ دِيى غُلْجِنْ دِنْ ، كَارَفْكَ دِيِي وَدَ بِيلِنْ كِرْتِرُ سِككُنَ ادّيي كٌَولْزُ كَرَفْكَ سُودِرُ بَنَا سٗودعَ كُلاَ شِ شَرَيِنْ بَعَ سَندِ بَسُو بَينْزُنَ
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: سَلْ كَرفْكَ كُومَينْ يِديى نِمْ يا أوَء دَوَرتَ دِعَ رُزُنَا كَوُ كلاَ لَمَر دِيَيَنْ كُلاَشِ سَدِنْدُو سَوَرتِينْ دِعَ نُوتعَ كُرُ بَينْنَا كُنْغُنَ دُو وَكِلْاَ كلِيفْ سْتَينْس دِيي فَيدَتَنَا دَعَ نوزَنْ سورُ
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: كُلاَشِ سِتَينْس دِيي سِدِنْ دِ كلاَ حَرَجِ سو دِ سُورُ فِتِ نِمْ يَا أوَ دَوَررَتَ دِيَينْ بَيجِ لَا بَ، أدِيي شِدع شِمَ كَزَدَلَ كٗلاَ كُورَ كُرُ كُلاشِي فُرتُو كُومِتِي هَوُسْ عِنَجِي أنْ كُومَينسْ كُومِتِى يَوُ
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: غُمْنَ كِرِ مَاساتَشوستس يي مِتْ رُومْنِي دِ شِمَ كَرْنْو كُرَ لَردِيِي غَنَمَا يِمْ تَلَوٌوَء رُو سَدِنَ دِعَ سَنَ 46 لَدِنْ زُو فُرْتُ ألَمَ فُولُرِدَ رِفُوبِلِكَنْ فَاتِي يِي دِنْ
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.
